column1: # Optional hostile Ash Jenna confrontation after Venus Lighthouse. She is the evil Jenna from the sprite animation: unrepentant, dangerous, not redeemed. The original game ending remains unchanged.

column3: There you are, Isaac.\nI came to see\nwhat Venus would do.{end_wait}
The lighthouse broke.\n{actor_name:7} fell. {actor_name:5}\njumped after her.{end_wait}
So they may be dead.\nHow dreadful for you.{end_wait}
We don't know.\nWe're going to find\nthem.{end_wait}
You still think you\ncan save everyone.\nHow exhausting.{end_wait}
I watched the light\ntear the coast apart.\nBeautiful, wasn't it?{end_wait}

In my world, the
beacons burned too.{page_break}He let us die.
If he's watching now,
I hope he sees me.{end_wait}
We still don't know\nwhat destroyed\nyour world.{end_wait}
You want evidence.\nI want him afraid.\nWe're not alike.{end_wait}
I said I'd help\nfind the truth.{page_break}Not hurt people\nto get answers.{end_wait}

I refused to help.
I won't change
my mind now.{page_break}And I won't let
you hurt my friends.{end_wait}
Your {actor_name:6} and Kraden\nare still missing.\nGo chase them.{end_wait}
And Felix and Sheba.\nWe're not leaving\nthem behind.{end_wait}
Go, then.{page_break}If he won't answer,\nI'll make him regret it.{end_wait}
If you threaten\nmy friends, I'll\nstand against you.{end_wait}
You can try, {actor_name:1}.{page_break}But don't mistake me\nfor the girl you lost.{end_wait}
I know you're not.\nAnd I won't let you\nhurt my friends.{end_wait}
